author: ValWood
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**


GO:0000055 | ribosomal large subunit export from nucleus | IEA with ARBA00090252


* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC11G7.04

* **Description of issue**

I'm picking up an ARBA mapping  for " [ribosomal large subunit export from nucleus](https://www.yeastgenome.org/go/GO:0000055)"

which seems to derive from

https://www.yeastgenome.org/locus/S000001410#go


but this is clearly a downstream phenotype. This is the abstract of the paper used to make the annotation:

Pulse-chase, Northern blotting, and primer extension analyses in the L40-depleted strain clearly indicate that L40 is not strictly required for the precursor rRNA (pre-rRNA) processing reactions but contributes to optimal 27 SB pre-rRNA maturation. Moreover, depletion of L40 hinders the nucleo-cytoplasmic export of pre-60 S ribosomal particles. Importantly, all these defects most likely appear as the direct consequence of impaired [Nmd3](https://www.yeastgenome.org/locus/S000001213) and [Rlp24](https://www.yeastgenome.org/locus/S000003999) release from cytoplasmic pre-60 S ribosomal subunits and their inefficient recycling back into the nucle(ol)us.
